records.text: Sebastian Gorka was not cleared in the first Trump administration because of his past and ties to British intelligence, and he has long been accused of being a spy.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: he didn't even get cleared in the first administration because of his past and ties to British intelligence—his ties to British intelligence. So he's been accused of being a spy for a long time.

verification.notes: Reliable reporting confirms Gorka struggled to obtain the needed U.S. clearance in the first Trump administration. Separately, reporting on his failed 2002 Hungarian clearance cites suspicions of British counterintelligence ties. The statement compresses two different clearance episodes and overstates a long-running spy accusation.
